description: Blend a source layer and channel, from this or another open document of the same pixel size, into the active layer (Image > Apply Image), with a blending mode, opacity, invert and preserve transparency; add and subtract take scale and offset. Works inside the selection when there is one

offset.description: add and subtract: add this brightness. Default 0

scale.description: add and subtract: divide the result by this. Default 1

channel.description: "composite", "red", "green", "blue", "cyan", "magenta", "yellow", "black", "gray", "transparency", or an alpha channel name. Default composite

document.description: Open document name (same pixel size). Default the active document

layer.description: Layer name, or "merged" for all visible layers. Default the active layer

target.description: The layer to change. Default the active layer

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

name: apply_image
title: Apply Image
